Container.Name: SelfArchiver
Container.Overview: Self-hosted email archiver: pick exactly which IMAP folders to archive, build rules with filters (sender / subject / attachment / age), give each rule its own schedule, and optionally delete archived mail from the source mailbox to keep it small. Everything is stored in a single container (SQLite + full-text search + .eml files on disk). No external database required.
Container.License: Proprietary - free for private self-hosting, see project LICENSE
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mail email imap archive archiver backup eml retention sqlite
Container.Requires: Existing e-mail accounts with IMAP access. Set a UI password unless the instance runs in a trusted private network only.

Config.Name: Data path
Config.Description: SQLite database and the .eml archive. Grows with the archived mail - choose a share with enough space.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the SelfArchiver web interface.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Stable secret for encrypting stored mailbox passwords and signing sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it constant - changing it makes stored mailbox passwords unreadable. Empty = generated once and stored in the data folder.

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Password protecting the web UI. Empty = open instance (trusted private network only).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for the per-rule schedules.

Config.Name: Cron timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for evaluating the cron schedules. Normally the same as Timezone.

Config.Name: Cookie secure
Config.Description: Set to true when the UI is served over HTTPS only (reverse proxy), so the session cookie is sent over secure connections only.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn, error.
